posts.linkedin: Late-night food access is a real operational gap around universities: Westwood counters close by 22:00 while study sessions run past 01:00. Golden Boba is a single-city delivery operation built around that gap: batch brewing every 30 minutes, dorm-route couriers, 15-minute pickup windows, single-cup orders without delivery-app minimums. We price inside the market band ($6.50–8.75 per drink) and open with a Friday 10pm launch window for the Hill dorms. If you work on campus operations or student housing, I would like to hear how food access looks from your side. __SITE_URL__
